passages.text: Reason for referral: right knee pain and stiffness after a fall six weeks ago.
Evaluation: right knee flexion limited to 95 degrees. Quadriceps strength 3+/5. Antalgic gait. The patient reports difficulty climbing stairs at home.
Plan of care: therapeutic exercise (CPT 97110) twice weekly for six weeks. Goals: knee flexion to 120 degrees and independent stair climbing.
Plan of care signed by the treating physical therapist on 2026-04-07, before therapy began.
